children.text:
Get your money back fast with these claim tips:

• *Always Keep Invoices:* If paying upfront, ask for an itemised tax invoice showing the doctor’s provider number and Medicare item codes.

• *Claim via Your App:* Upload a photo of your receipt in your insurer’s mobile app (Bupa, Medibank, Allianz, etc.) for refunds within 2–5 business days.

• *Mind "The Gap":* OSHC covers 100% of the government-set Medicare Benefits Schedule (MBS) fee. If a private clinic charges higher rates, the difference is your out-of-pocket gap.

• *Shortcut:* Direct billing clinics eliminate the gap completely!
You paid for a doctor consultation upfront because the clinic does not offer direct billing. What key document must you request from the receptionist to claim your refund from your OSHC provider?

data-source.title: Option A
data-source.description: An informal handwritten note with only the doctor’s first name

data-source.title: Option B

data-source.title: Option C

data-source.title: Option D

children.text: A private GP clinic charges you $85 for a standard consultation, but your OSHC provider refunds you $42.85 (100% of the government MBS fee). What explains the difference?

data-source.title: Option A
data-source.description: The insurer applied a penalty because you visited a doctor on a weekday

data-source.title: Option B
data-source.description: The difference is the out-of-pocket gap fee set by the private medical practice

data-source.title: Option C
data-source.description: OSHC regulations require that only half of every medical claim can ever be paid

data-source.title: Option D
data-source.description: International students are not eligible for any doctor consultation benefits

children.text: You paid upfront for a medical consultation and want to receive your reimbursement as quickly as possible. What is generally the fastest way to submit your claim?

data-source.title: Option A
data-source.description: Upload a photo of your receipt via your OSHC mobile app or online portal

data-source.title: Option B

data-source.title: Option C

children.text: Before booking an appointment with a specialist or non-direct billing clinic, what practical step should you take to avoid unexpected medical bills?

data-source.title: Option A
data-source.description: Ask the clinic about their consultation fee and any out-of-pocket gap upfront

data-source.title: Option B
data-source.description: Assume all private specialist fees are fully covered with zero gap automatically

data-source.title: Option C
data-source.description: Request that the Australian government pay the doctor before your appointment

data-source.title: Option D
data-source.description: Pay the maximum estimated fee into an overseas bank account prior to arrival

children.text: You submit a successful online OSHC claim for doctor fees you paid upfront. Into what kind of bank account can the insurer deposit your benefit refund?

data-source.title: Option A
data-source.description: An active Australian bank account nominated in your online member profile

data-source.title: Option B
data-source.description: Any foreign currency credit card issued by an overseas department store

data-source.title: Option C
data-source.description: A digital cryptocurrency wallet linked to an anonymous online account

data-source.title: Option D
data-source.description: An overseas joint account registered under a former high school teacher

children.text:
*Correct Answer:* Option B (An itemized medical receipt with provider number and MBS item codes)

💡 *Explanation:* To process your claim, insurers require an itemized tax invoice or receipt showing the doctor’s provider number, date of service, MBS item numbers, and the amount paid.

🔗 *Source Reference:* [How to Claim | Medibank Overseas Student Health Cover](https://www.medibankoshc.com.au/how-to-make-an-online-claim/)
https://www.medibankoshc.com.au/how-to-make-an-online-claim/

*Correct Answer:* Option B (The difference is the out-of-pocket gap fee set by the private medical practice)

💡 *Explanation:* In Australia, doctors can set their own consultation fees above the government MBS schedule fee. The difference between what the doctor charges and what your insurer pays is your out-of-pocket gap fee.

🔗 *Source Reference:* [What to do if you get sick in Australia](https://www.medibank.com.au/overseas-health-insurance/guides/articles/getting-sick-in-australia/)
https://www.medibank.com.au/overseas-health-insurance/guides/articles/getting-sick-in-australia/

*Correct Answer:* Option A (Upload a photo of your receipt via your OSHC mobile app or online portal)

💡 *Explanation:* Submitting claims online or through your insurer’s mobile app by uploading a photo of your receipt is the fastest method.

🔗 *Source Reference:* [How to Claim | Medibank Overseas Student Health Cover](https://www.medibankoshc.com.au/how-to-make-an-online-claim/)
https://www.medibankoshc.com.au/how-to-make-an-online-claim/

*Correct Answer:* Option A (Ask the clinic about their consultation fee and any out-of-pocket gap upfront)

💡 *Explanation:* Under Informed Financial Consent, it is always wise to ask the provider in advance what they charge and how much may be out-of-pocket, then check with your insurer to understand what benefit you will receive back.

🔗 *Source Reference:* [What you need to know about the Australian healthcare system](https://www.medibank.com.au/overseas-health-insurance/guides/articles/understanding-australian-healthcare/)
https://www.medibank.com.au/overseas-health-insurance/guides/articles/understanding-australian-healthcare/

*Correct Answer:* Option A (An active Australian bank account nominated in your online member profile)

💡 *Explanation:* OSHC benefit payments are issued in Australian dollars and can only be deposited directly into an active Australian bank account. Ensuring your bank details are up to date in your member portal ensures fast reimbursement.

🔗 *Source Reference:* [Medibank OSHC Member Guide](https://www.medibank.com.au/content/dam/b2c/docs/mpl/Medibank_OSHC_Member_Guide.pdf)
https://www.medibank.com.au/content/dam/b2c/docs/mpl/Medibank_OSHC_Member_Guide.pdf
